mission: F11 screenplay authoring — ODG routine creative decisions (recorded, not escalated)

decisions.choice: OPTION B — Björn learns to read and makes the sacrifice himself; the canon rule is preserved intact (no rule change).
decisions.rejected: OPTION A (revise the rule so a non-reader can hold the door by force) — rejected because it weakens the established mystery rule and makes the climax about muscle, contradicting Björn's arc.
decisions.rationale: Nefer-Ka's rule ('only someone who can read it walks in and does not return') is the mystery's spine. Option B turns that constraint into Björn's ARC engine: the brute whose sword cannot cut tides or time must learn the one thing he disdained — to read — and the cost of finally understanding is that he is the one who must walk in. This (a) keeps the male protagonist decisive at the climax, (b) preserves the canon rule, (c) pays off his three flaws at once (strength is not enough; he faces his deep-water dread by stepping into a seam that feels like drowning; he masters his rage into a calm, chosen act), and (d) makes his final decisive action NOT a sword-swing — he plants Himinkljúfr and steps through.
decisions.preserves: world identity + time-travel premise fully intact

decisions.choice: Björn is Olaf's younger kinsman and the crew's warrior from SC01 — present throughout, not a late arrival. Olaf (aging) cedes leadership to Björn across Act I.
decisions.rationale: A protagonist must anchor the opening. Folding him in as kin to Olaf reuses the existing captain/mentor structure without inventing a disconnected lead.

decisions.id: DEC-3 (the two secondary females act as intel/origin, never decisive)
decisions.choice: ASTRID = the reader whose intel Björn depends on and who teaches him to read (secondary). MERYT = origin-of-the-tear (her grief caused it) and conscience (secondary). Neither is the decisive agent in any scene.
decisions.rationale: Keeps exactly two women, both genuinely secondary, while giving them real, non-decorative function (knowledge + moral origin) — not relabeled leads.
